query: AMD EPYC server CPU revenue contribution to data center segment
normalized: amd center contribution cpu data epyc revenue segment server

output.content:
AMD does **not** disclose EPYC server-CPU revenue as a separate dollar amount or percentage of its Data Center segment; the segment aggregates server CPUs with AI accelerators, GPUs, DPUs/NICs, FPGAs, and other data-center products. [[1]] 

For FY2025, AMD reported Data Center revenue of **$16.635 billion**, up from **$12.579 billion** in FY2024; management attributed the increase to demand for both fifth-generation EPYC processors and Instinct MI350 GPUs, but did not quantify either product family’s individual contribution. [[2]] [[1]] 

Thus, EPYC is a material driver of Data Center revenue and growth, but any precise EPYC revenue contribution—or EPYC share of the $16.6 billion segment total—would be an external estimate rather than an AMD-reported figure. [[2]] [[1]]
